description.value: Sushi Mania is a Japanese restaurant on Main Street in Vancouver, serving a broad menu that includes nigiri, sashimi, maki rolls, udon, teriyaki, tempura, and donburi. Located at Main & 22nd, it sits along a well-travelled urban cycling corridor and offers online ordering for takeout. The menu covers a wide range of Japanese staples suited to a mid-ride meal or post-ride refuel.
